title: Bio-derived carbon adsorbents from Terminalia arjuna bark for efficient bisphenol A removal: mechanistic insights toward sustainable water treatment
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4500-4517
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09019A, Paper
Open Access

A. S. Pathiraja, K. D. A. Dulanjana, G. Rajapaksa, P. W. Samarasekere
The development of sustainable sorbent materials capable of removing endocrine-disrupting contaminants from water is a pressing environmental challenge addressed here using KOH-activated carbon from Terminalia arjuna bark for efficient BPA removal.
